announcements.headline: Silver Bullet Data Services Group
announcements.insight: Shares are suspended following a delisting vote. Shareholders face potential loss of liquidity as the company exits the market.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Silver Bullet Data Services Group PLC
announcements.insight: Shares are suspended following earlier delisting proposals and meeting results. Shareholders should monitor for the replacement accounting date and final outcomes of the delisting process.

announcements.headline: Accounting date, Results & Suspension -Replacement
announcements.insight: Shares are suspended following a proposed delisting approved in June. This replacement results announcement confirms the accounting date and accounts for the exit.

announcements.headline: Accounting Reference Date, Accounts & Suspension
announcements.insight: Shares are suspended following the June delisting vote. This marks a critical escalation in the exit process initiated earlier this year.

announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The general meeting result follows the June delisting proposal. This outcome determines whether Silver Bullet Data Services Group proceeds with its planned AIM exit.

announcements.headline: Proposed AIM Delisting & Notice of General Meeting
announcements.insight: SBDS proposes AIM delisting and calls a general meeting. Shareholders should watch for voting outcomes regarding this potential exit from the exchange.
